sections.heading: P vs. L: Customization Menu vs. Custom Lighting Toggle
sections.intro: MAHANAKHON RACING uses two separate key commands for bike appearance: P opens the customization menu at designated points, while L toggles decorative lighting during rides. Understanding the difference prevents confusion when you want to style your bike versus when you want to activate custom lights on the road.
paragraphs: Press P only when you are standing at a customization location in the game world. The customization menu will not open if you press P while riding, in open areas, or away from a customization point. Once the menu appears, you can adjust your motorcycle's colors, decals, and other styling options before leaving the area.

The L key serves a different purpose: it activates decorative lights on your motorcycle while you are riding. These custom lights are cosmetic additions that do not affect performance or gameplay, but they enhance your bike's visual presence during trips around the map. Press L at any time during a ride to toggle these lights on or off.

If you are unsure whether you are at a customization point, attempt to press P. If nothing happens, move to another location or check the map for marked customization zones. Once customization opens and you have made your style choices, press Space to exit your bike or use the on-screen exit button to leave the menu and confirm your changes.

sections.heading: Next Steps After Customizing Your Motorcycle
sections.intro: Once you've finished customizing your motorcycle's appearance at a customization point, press Space to exit the bike and leave the styling interface. Your changes are saved automatically, so your custom colors, decals, and helmet selections remain applied to your motorcycle.
paragraphs: After customization, you have several options depending on your gameplay goal. If you want to see your new look in action, spawn a fresh bike using G and take it for a test ride around the game world. This lets you view your customized design from different angles and confirm the changes match your vision before committing to longer rides or races.

Alternatively, return to farming, exploration, or your next objective. Your customization persists across sessions, so you can always revisit a customization point later to make additional adjustments or try a different color scheme. There's no penalty for changing your bike's appearance multiple times.

faq.question: How do I customize a motorcycle in MAHANAKHON RACING?
faq.answer: Ride or walk to a designated customization point in the game world, then press P to open the customization interface. The P key only works at these specific locations—it will not function while riding in open areas. Once the menu appears, select the category you want to modify (paint, decals, lighting, or helmet), make your changes, and confirm before exiting to apply them to your motorcycle.

faq.question: Where do I find a customization point?
faq.answer: Customization points are fixed locations scattered across the MAHANAKHON RACING world. Look for marked zones, garages, or parking areas where other players gather to modify their bikes. The game does not provide an in-game map listing every point, so exploration and community resources are your best tools. Once you locate a customization zone, bookmark the spot mentally or use the N warp key to return quickly in future sessions.

faq.question: What is the difference between P and L in MAHANAKHON RACING?
faq.answer: P opens the full customization menu when you stand at a designated customization point, allowing you to change colors, decals, lighting options, and helmet styles. L toggles your custom lighting on and off while riding—it does not open a menu. Use P to design your lighting setup at a customization zone, then use L on the road to turn those custom lights on or off as you ride.
